subject.title: Feature request: add prefix/list-style skill discovery to ClawHub CLI search

question: Which stable ClawHub registry discovery contract should be exposed for exact slug lookup and slug-prefix enumeration?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but the public API/CLI contract and moderation visibility semantics are product decisions that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Add explicit exact/prefix discovery
options.body: Add indexed, cursor-pageable exact and prefix filters to the public registry API and expose them through clear CLI flags or a dedicated hub-list mode.

options.title: Keep search relevance-only
options.body: Document that ranked search is not an enumeration API and leave this issue open only if a separate registry-browse product task is desired.

options.title: Defer to broader registry filters
options.body: Fold prefix/exact discovery into a larger owner, publisher, tag, and namespace filtering design before implementation.

recommendation.title: Add explicit exact/prefix discovery
recommendation.body: Add indexed, cursor-pageable exact and prefix filters to the public registry API and expose them through clear CLI flags or a dedicated hub-list mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant API and CLI surfaces are CODEOWNERS-assigned to @Patrick-Erichsen and current-line blame points to Patrick's recent work in those paths.
